run_spm_decode_pieces: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode piece tokens from an input file using a model
run_spm_decode_ids: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode token IDs from an input file using a model
run_spm_decode_unk: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode IDs with unknown tokens remapped to zero
review_main: review the main function that parses arguments and decodes sentencepiece tokens from an input file
review_tok2int: review the tok2int helper function that remaps unknown tokens to integer zero
